decision.reasoning_trace: The decision is based on the product ratings, reviews, and features. The G.SKILL USB KM360 Professional Tenkeyless Mechanical Keyboard has a high rating of 4.7 and a large number of reviews, indicating its popularity and quality. The SteelSeries Apex Pro Mini Mechanical Gaming Keyboard and the GK GAMAKAY LK67 65% RGB Mechanical Keyboard are also considered due to their high ratings and positive reviews. The DROP + Invyr Holy Panda Mechanical Keyboard Switches are included in the consideration set due to their high rating and relevance to mechanical keyboards. The YMDK Idobao x ID75 75 Keys Ortholinear Layout VIA Anodized Aluminum Case is also considered due to its unique features and high rating.
